answer: Proposal: pay each identity a flat per-epoch reward, released only when beacon-random spot checks confirm storage sealed under its key; re-sealing outlasts the challenge window, so one disk cannot serve two keys. M clones need M disks: splitting finds no haven from cost. Rentals set the bound: the reward must stay below the pledge's rental price over the same horizon. Clones carry no ferrous signature; the design leans on arithmetic, not detection. Fraud proofs slash the seat and mark it sable. Vulnerable: if rewards outgrow storage prices, the bound inverts.
